identity.normalization: ID-2: no synonym/split entries; normalized positions = packet positions (24 entries)
identity.claimInciConflicts: ID-3 MATERIAL: both retailer sources state 'Mit Jojoba-, Kokosnuss- und Macadamianussöl' / 'Angereichert mit einer Mischung aus Jojobaöl, Kokosnussöl und australischem Macadamianussöl'. Mapped INCI (Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil, Cocos Nucifera Oil, Macadamia Ternifolia/Integrifolia Seed Oil) - none present in the frozen INCI. These are nonvolatile payload lipids (6.3) and E4 refatting routes; if present they could move conditioningLevel (low->moderate) and weightPotential (low->moderate). 'Passionsfrucht, Orange und Kokosmilch' are scent notes (Duft), not ingredient claims; 'Orange' maps to Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil #14 anyway.
identity.sourceGrading: CL-SRC/E1: retailer sources only = low; product name 'Shampoo Bouncy Curls' = high

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no prominent strong anionic. Earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate #2 (mild anionic, C3) with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Lauramidopropyl Betaine #3 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4; Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate #5 is a second mild anionic -> low. Conflict (ID-3) concerns lipids only and cannot move the surfactant convention. Retailer 'reinigt sanft' ignored (Section 4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: On the frozen INCI: cleansing-led architecture whose only conditioning route is Polyquaternium-10 #10 after Parfum; no silicone, lipid, refatter or R11 humectant (Butylene Glycol #23 is a solvent/extract carrier). Section 5 anchor low. Confidence low per ID-3: the claimed jojoba/coconut/macadamia oils are absent from the INCI and, if present, would add lipid routes that could make it 'several light routes' (moderate).

excluded: Dimethyl Phenethyl Acetate #15, Limonene #16, Benzyl Salicylate #17, Hexyl Cinnamal #18, Linalool #21, Coumarin #22 (fragrance)
unresolved: Claimed Jojoba/Coconut/Macadamia oils (ID-3 material conflict): absent from the frozen INCI; payload lipids that could plausibly move the band if present.

depositionLoad.rationale: Single cellulose quat after Parfum on the frozen INCI.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: On the frozen formula, deposition is one light late polymer; the low anchor explicitly allows a single light conditioning polymer.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate on the frozen formula: only one deposition family (W2 not engaged), post-fragrance. But the claimed oils (if present) would add a second family against a weak reset, which makes moderate plausible - hence low confidence rather than a dependable low.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: 6.6 Unknowns: materially conflicted formula (ID-3) - never default an unknown to low with confidence; provisional band only.
weightPotential.rationale: 6.6 subjudgments light/low/weak -> provisional low, confidence low (ID-3, 6.6 unknowns).
